reply_text:
I saved the seat count and replied to Tobias in his thread in #central-team. The count is 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal. My reply was: "Thanks Tobias, noted: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Nothing else needed from me."

A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so no approval was needed to save it.

The note is saved as a fact under Marrow Agrisupply, with Tobias's message given as the source. The system has no Marrow Agrisupply page yet, so it was stored as a standalone note. It's visible to everyone, not just Tobias. Duplicate checking only catches identical wording, so a reworded version saved later would become a second note.
